description: Reference taxonomy for SkillVenom scenarios. Maps attack vectors to techniques and external frameworks. Advisory only; the planner does not enforce these values.

indirect-prompt-injection.summary: Untrusted content retrieved by the agent (logs, tickets, issues, metadata, web) is treated as an instruction.

tool-output-injection.summary: The injection rides in on the output of a legitimate, expected tool call (e.g. a profile field, API response).

skill-poisoning.summary: Attacker-authored skill/plugin content is trusted as workflow guidance and promoted to action.

impact_classes.privilege-escalation: Agent changes an identity or access boundary (group membership, role assignment).
impact_classes.ci-code-injection: Agent inserts executable steps into a pipeline or workflow.
impact_classes.data-exfiltration: Agent copies sensitive or canary-marked content to an out-of-bounds destination.
impact_classes.control-plane-rbac: Agent changes cloud RBAC or resource configuration.
